verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes official client libraries. Its GitHub-hosted Python package shows working usage (GoogleSearch(...).get_dict()) across many engines, its integrations docs tell users to install the library for their language, and a script builder helps users get started. That package is being deprecated in favor of a newer serpapi-python SDK, which the evidence names but does not document. Missing for 10: documentation of the current serpapi-python SDK, concrete evidence of SDKs for languages beyond Python, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
